The coalition hasn't held a leaders' meeting since August, as momentum faded after the US and Israel launched their war on Iran. 🌍 Grossi cannot conceal IAEA’s double standards toward Iran: Baqaei

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says that Rafael Grossi cannot use Israel’s non-membership in the Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) to cover up the International Atomic Energy Agency’s indifference toward the Israeli regime’s nuclear arsenal and its double standards toward Iran’s nuclear program.

In a post on his X account early on Thursday, Baqaei wrote, “IAEA Director General Grossi has stated: "[...] there is no double standard. If Israel was a state party to the NPT and I was treating Iran and Israel differently then there would be a double standard."
​
The official noted, “This response confuses formal legal status with institutional responsibility and impartiality. The real question is why a genocidal occupying entity possessing a nuclear arsenal remains outside comprehensive safeguards, and how this inequality can be reconciled with the stated objectives of the non-proliferation regime.”
​
“Grossi appears to have overlooked the landmark 1995 Resolution on the Middle East, adopted with the endorsement of the US, Russia, and the UK. That resolution called for all in the Middle East, “without exception,” to accede to the NPT and place all their nuclear facilities under comprehensive IAEA safeguards,” he added.
​
The spokesperson stressed, “The 2000 NPT Review Conference specifically reaffirmed the importance of Israel’s accession to the Treaty and its acceptance of comprehensive safeguards. This resolution formed an integral part of the package of agreements that made the indefinite extension of the NPT possible.”
​
Baqaei added, “The question of Israeli regime is therefore not a new political demand; it is rooted in the historical commitments and understandings that underpinned the non-proliferation regime itself.”
​
Noting that, “The IAEA cannot invoke this formal distinction to dismiss questions about the NPT’s failure to achieve universality and the resulting inequality in nuclear security in the region.”
​
The official also stressed, “If NPT membership is the basis for holding Iran accountable, then Israel’s non-membership must not be allowed to serve as a permanent shield against demands that it accede to the Treaty and accept comprehensive safeguards.”
​
“Impartiality cannot be measured solely by how the Agency enforces the obligations of existing members while remaining silent about the regime’s failure to address those that remain outside it,” he added.
​
Baqaei further emphasized, “The IAEA’s double standards do not end there. Regarding incidents at Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant, Grossi explicitly stated: “I condemn any violent action inside or around the plant.” Yet after the United States and Israel bombed Iran’s nuclear facilities, he limited himself to the general assertion that nuclear facilities should not be attacked, refraining from explicitly condemning those responsible.”
​
Stressing, “When “I condemn” is used in one case and carefully qualified language is substituted in the other, the double standard is unmistakable. It undermines the credibility of the Agency and weakens the foundations of the non-proliferation regime.”

Full text of the declaration:

President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Putin, President of the People's Republic of China Xi Jinping and President of the United States of America Donald Trump held a meeting in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026. The heads of state of Russia and the United States expressed their gratitude to China for organizing and hosting this historic trilateral summit. The leaders of the three states held a thorough exchange of views on the current international situation and expressed their commitment to maintaining strategic stability and international security.

1. As permanent members of the UN Security Council, Russia, China and the United States expressed their commitment to reforming the UN so that it can respond more effectively to global challenges and fulfill its fundamental mission in the field of international peace and security.

2. The three states plan to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products for the benefit of all countries. They reaffirmed the importance of stable energy supplies.

3. The leaders of the three states note that the principle of state consent and respect for the immunities of state officials are of fundamental importance, and agree that the International Criminal Court and other similar bodies must not abuse their powers.

4. The leaders of the three states reaffirmed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought. The three countries will hold a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons.

📡 Iran urges regional countries to prevent US use of their territory for attacks

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Foreign Ministry has defended the Armed Forces’ response to the US attacks as an exercise of the country’s inherent right to self-defense, urging regional countries to prevent Washington from using their territory and military bases for operations against Iran.

In a statement issued early on Thursday, the ministry strongly condemned recent US attacks on areas along Iran’s southern coast, saying Iranian forces targeted US Patriot air defense systems and drone and missile launch platforms at two regional bases used to support attacks against the country.
​
The foreign ministry stressed that Iran’s defensive actions are aimed at the sources and infrastructure supporting the aggression, holding the United States responsible for the regional consequences of its use of force.
​
It also warned that allowing the US to use regional territory and facilities for attacks against Iran could constitute an act of aggression under international law, adding that Tehran has so far exercised restraint and targeted only US military bases and assets in those countries.
​
The statement further called on the United Nations, particularly the Security Council, to fulfill its responsibilities under the UN Charter and warned that any renewed aggression against Iran would face a decisive response from the Iranian Armed Forces.
